name: popover
title: Popover
description: Anchored interactive panel with trigger, anchor and close parts, built on Reka UI.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PopoverRootEmits, PopoverRootProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { PopoverRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'

const props = defineProps<PopoverRootProps>()
const emits = defineEmits<PopoverRootEmits>()

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <PopoverRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="popover"
    v-bind="forwarded"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </PopoverRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PopoverAnchorProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { PopoverAnchor, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'

const props = defineProps<PopoverAnchorProps>()
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props)
</script>

<template>
  <PopoverAnchor data-slot="popover-anchor" v-bind="forwarded">
    <slot />
  </PopoverAnchor>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PopoverCloseProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { PopoverClose, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'

const props = defineProps<PopoverCloseProps>()
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props)
</script>

<template>
  <PopoverClose data-slot="popover-close" v-bind="forwarded">
    <slot />
  </PopoverClose>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PopoverContentEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { PopoverContentProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { PopoverContent, PopoverPortal, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { popoverPanelClass } from './styles'

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<PopoverContentProps>(), {
  sideOffset: 4,
  align: 'center',
})
const emits = defineEmits<PopoverContentEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <PopoverPortal>
    <PopoverContent
      data-slot="popover-content"
      v-bind="{ ...$attrs, ...forwarded }"
      :class="cn(
        popoverPanelClass,
        'max-h-(--reka-popover-content-available-height) w-72 origin-(--reka-popover-content-transform-origin)',
        props.class,
      )"
    >
      <slot />
    </PopoverContent>
  </PopoverPortal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PopoverTriggerProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { PopoverTrigger, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'

const props = defineProps<PopoverTriggerProps>()
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props)
</script>

<template>
  <PopoverTrigger data-slot="popover-trigger" v-bind="forwarded">
    <slot />
  </PopoverTrigger>
</template>

import type { PopoverContentProps as RekaPopoverContentProps } from 'reka-ui'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'

export { popoverPanelClass } from './styles'
export { default as Popover } from './Popover.vue'
export { default as PopoverAnchor } from './PopoverAnchor.vue'
export { default as PopoverClose } from './PopoverClose.vue'
export { default as PopoverContent } from './PopoverContent.vue'
export { default as PopoverTrigger } from './PopoverTrigger.vue'

export interface PopoverContentProps extends RekaPopoverContentProps {
  /** Extra classes, merged with the base classes through `cn()`. */
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

/** Classes shared by every floating panel that looks like a popover (Popover, HoverCard). */
export const popoverPanelClass = 'z-50 max-w-[calc(100vw-1rem)] overflow-y-auto rounded-md border bg-popover p-4 text-popover-foreground shadow-md outline-hidden data-[state=closed]:animate-[elf-fade-out_100ms_ease-in_forwards] data-[state=open]:animate-[elf-zoom-in_120ms_ease-out] motion-reduce:animate-none!'
